skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand the nature of risk and the role of insurance in managing it.
Grasp the concepts, characteristics, and operational mechanisms of social insurance.
Comprehend the principles and operational mechanisms of health insurance.
Understand the principles and operational mechanisms of unemployment insurance.
Learn about the principles, types, and operational mechanisms of commercial insurance.
Understand the principles and operational mechanisms of deposit insurance.
Apply knowledge of insurance principles to analyze and manage insurance operations.
Develop critical thinking skills for analyzing and solving problems in insurance management.
Acquire skills for independent research and analysis in insurance studies.
Demonstrate responsibility and teamwork when working independently or in groups.
Develop skills for presenting research findings and analysis effectively.
